deleteAccount.title: Delete Account
deleteAccount.headline: Permanently delete your account
deleteAccount.intro: When you delete your account, the following is removed immediately and permanently:

items.garments: Every piece in your wardrobe and its details
items.account: Your account, profile, preferences and sign-in details

deleteAccount.permanent: This cannot be undone. Deleted data cannot be recovered.
deleteAccount.reasonPlaceholder: Your feedback helps us improve RYVENCA.
deleteAccount.confirmCheck: I understand that my account and all my data will be permanently deleted.
deleteAccount.appleNote: For your security you'll be asked to confirm with Apple once more; RYVENCA's Sign in with Apple access is then revoked as well.
deleteAccount.googleNote: RYVENCA's access to your Google account will be removed as well.
deleteAccount.confirmMessage: Your account and all your data will be deleted now. Are you sure?

deleted.title: Your account was deleted
